validate.name: one hunk
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 a
-b
+c

validate.name: counts default to one
a rename is not an original file
a parent segment is refused
an absolute path is refused
a backslash is refused
a drive colon is refused
a dot segment is refused
a file may appear once
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b

validate.name: two files are fine
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b
diff --git a/g.txt b/g.txt
--- a/g.txt
+++ b/g.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b

validate.name: a hunk needs a file
a malformed hunk header is refused
the old count must match the body
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 a
-b

validate.name: the new count must match the body
a truncated hunk that ends in a newline is reported as an unprefixed line
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 a
-b

validate.name: a hunk with a surplus line is reported as an unprefixed line
an unprefixed line is refused
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-a
+b
xyz

validate.name: a blank context line stripped of its space is refused
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 a

 c

validate.name: a second hunk must keep the cumulative coordinates
a second hunk with shifted coordinates is accepted
overlapping hunks are refused
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 a
-b
+c
@@ -2,1 +2,1 @@
-b
+d

validate.name: an empty patch has no sections
a file without a hunk has no sections
the no-newline witness is not counted
validate.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
\ No newline at end of file
+b
\ No newline at end of file

validate.name: a hunk that inserts at the very start
coordinates beyond the safe integers are refused

additions.name: added lines of two files
additions.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 a
+one
diff --git a/g.txt b/g.txt
--- a/g.txt
+++ b/g.txt
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 a
+two

additions.name: a later removal cancels an earlier addition
additions.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
 a
+gone
+kept
@@ -9 +11,1 @@
-gone

additions.name: blank additions are ignored and indentation is kept
additions.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
 a
+   
+  keep

additions.name: a file with only context owns no additions
additions.patch:
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
 a

additions.name: a patch with no target has no owner

receipt.name: applied additions and context are receipted by the sha256 of the real bytes
receipt.patch:
diff --git a/a.js b/a.js
--- a/a.js
+++ b/a.js
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 x
+new
 z

receipt.name: two owned files
receipt.patch:
diff --git a/a.js b/a.js
--- a/a.js
+++ b/a.js
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 x
+new
 z
diff --git a/b/c.js b/b/c.js
--- a/b/c.js
+++ b/b/c.js
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 q
+r

receipt.name: a requested line that is missing is refused
receipt.patch:
diff --git a/a.js b/a.js
--- a/a.js
+++ b/a.js
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 x
+new
 z
receipt.error: Requested tool patch was not applied: a.js

receipt.name: changed context after the hunk is refused
receipt.patch:
diff --git a/a.js b/a.js
--- a/a.js
+++ b/a.js
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 x
+new
 z
receipt.error: Exact SDK post-hunk context changed: a.js

receipt.name: context that moved to another position is refused
receipt.patch:
diff --git a/a.js b/a.js
--- a/a.js
+++ b/a.js
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 x
+new
 z
receipt.error: Exact SDK post-hunk context changed: a.js

receipt.name: an invalid patch is refused before any file is read

apply.name: carriage returns are content and survive
an insertion into an empty file
a hunk that starts beyond the file is refused
a removed line with different newline state is refused
an insertion after the last line
